name: kuu-orchestration
description: Native-subagent delivery with Fast Luna Max implementation, Deep Sol High implementation, fresh Sol High review, and primary integration.

interface.shortDescription: Route Fast and Deep implementation through isolated review.
interface.longDescription: Kuu Orchestration keeps decomposition, routing, integration, and acceptance in the primary task. It uses native GPT-5.6 Luna Max subagents for bounded Fast implementation, GPT-5.6 Sol High subagents for Deep implementation, and a fresh GPT-5.6 Sol High reviewer for every review round. User-visible tasks are reserved for durable work that must outlive the parent, needs direct follow-up, owns an independent worktree, or waits on external state.
defaultPrompt: Use Kuu Orchestration to route, implement, review, integrate, and verify this software change.
